page.overview:
Who is Ramcharan?

Ramcharan was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century, serving under Admiral Leyton.

In 2372, Ramcharan was assigned to Personnel Deployment, with an effective date of 49351. Ramcharan officer was one of over four hundred officers reassigned in a three week period by Leyton. The officer's name was listed in the personnel assignment log that was displayed on a screen in Benjamin Sisko's temporary office in Starfleet Headquarters. (, okudagram)
